description: Registry of trusted legal reviewers. The coding agent does NOT write to this file during normal operation. Adding a reviewer requires CEO approval and a governance record. This file was created in Round 26 (2026-08-21) as part of the Article XXVI violation fix. It starts EMPTY — no trusted reviewers exist yet.

governance_policy.adding_reviewers: To add a reviewer, the CEO must approve and a governance record must be created in protocol/governance/. The record must include: reviewer identity, credential source, independence declaration, and CEO approval timestamp. The coding agent cannot self-approve reviewers.
governance_policy.removing_reviewers: Set active=false. Do not delete entries — preserve the audit trail.

reviewer_types.HUMAN_EXPERT: A real human patent attorney with verifiable credentials (USPTO registration number, bar admission, etc.)
reviewer_types.AI_ENSEMBLE: An independent multi-model ensemble with no shared intermediate reasoning. Must have a documented independence architecture.
reviewer_types.EXTERNAL_SERVICE: An external API/service that provides legal analysis with its own attestation mechanism.
